description: This file defines the MediaScannerActivity class, an Android activity that provides an interface for simulating media scanning and inserting dummy media data (albums, songs) into the device's media content provider. It includes UI setup, broadcast receivers for media scanning, methods to generate and insert random media data, and handlers for user interactions.

classes.name: MediaScannerActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that manages media scanning simulation, user interactions, and media data insertion.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and registers broadcast receivers.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by unregistering receivers and removing handlers.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Triggers the media scanner by sending an ACTION_MEDIA_MOUNTED broadcast.

methods.name: setInsertButtonText
methods.description: Updates the insert button's label to reflect the number of items to insert.

methods.name: insertItems
methods.description: Handles the insertion of media items in a loop using a handler.

methods.name: addAlbum
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new album with associated songs into the media store with randomized data.

methods.name: getRandomWord
methods.description: Generates a random 'word' by concatenating predefined syllables.

methods.name: getRandomName
methods.description: Generates a random person name with optional prefixes for last names.
